_comment: The current car build (combined-aux-boot-ringtone) plus aux-boot-restore, the candidate fix for booting to FM. NOT tested on hardware; the restore path is verified only under emulation; the handler-only version was flashed 2026-09-28 and still booted to FM. LOCAL build manifest: edit the paths below before reusing.

_pairs.aux-boot-default: forces the restored Last_Source to 7; falsified on its own, needed as half of the pair
_pairs.aux-boot-restore: AUX boot request (InitApp) and later requests (input handler) sent without PrOnly so they reach the restore, and the restored priority is forced to AUX's 20; the input handler follows the AUX input setting, not the signal, so no auto-switch on signal is expected
_pairs.spy-dump-userdata-partition: SPYSTORE also copies /USER_DATA; a different address, no overlap

_settings: No USER_DATA payload, so the car's own settings - paired phones, destinations, presets - are NOT touched.
